object_description: elongated three-story building with a walkable green roof
design_condition: The building is carefully embedded in the existing terrain and park, extending the green landscape onto its roof while preserving hedges and minimizing paved areas, though its proximity to the outdoor pool limits landscape continuity.

positive.statement: The roof landscape is a surprising and pleasing gesture that enlarges the outdoor space and strengthens the green oasis.

position.rationale: Distinct elevated roof plate is clearly visible as the elongated upper footprint.

positive.statement: The architecture integrates independently into the park, with minimal paved areas benefiting the urban climate.

position.rationale: Long embedded mass and reduced external footprint visibly support park integration.

positive.statement: Separate routes for the public, athletes, and operations promise smooth operation.

position.target: separate public, athlete, and operations routes
position.rationale: Separate routes are interior and inferred within the elongated plan.

positive.statement: The indoor pool clearly distinguishes dirty, wet, and clean areas.

position.target: indoor pool wet and clean areas
position.rationale: Internal pool zoning is not separable, so the central elongated mass provides an approximate anchor.

positive.statement: The direct visual connection between the indoor and outdoor pools is very welcome.

position.target: visual connection between indoor and outdoor pools
position.rationale: Connection is inferred toward the pool-facing side of the embedded building.

positive.statement: Careful embedding into the existing terrain ensures an exceptionally small excavation volume.

position.rationale: Low elongated volume and shallow elevations visibly indicate terrain embedding.

positive.statement: The supporting concept is comprehensible and resource-saving in the intended construction method.

position.rationale: Resource-saving construction judgment has no specific spatial referent.

positive.statement: The insulated building shell ensures low winter heating requirements, while the green roof contributes to summer cooling.

position.target: insulated building shell and green roof
position.rationale: Envelope and roof are visible, although insulation and cooling performance are not geometric.

negative.statement: The bicycle parking and right of way are too far from the main entrance.

position.target: bicycle parking and right of way
position.rationale: Access elements are approximated near the lower-left approach to the elongated building.

negative.statement: The small distance from the outdoor pool weakens the landscape effect and spaciousness.

position.rationale: Pool-side open space is approximated along the building’s right-hand side.

negative.statement: Better access to the park outside the bathing season would be desirable.

position.rationale: Park access is assigned to the open left-side perimeter.

negative.statement: The permanent, low-maintenance design of the walkable green roof remains doubtful.

position.rationale: The walkable roof plate is distinctly visible, while maintenance performance remains non-geometric.

negative.statement: A substrate depth of only 20 centimetres may not ensure the required safety for roof use.

position.rationale: Roof surface is visible, but substrate depth is not represented.

negative.statement: The facades lack functional summer heat protection.

position.rationale: Long low facades are clearly visible in the elevations; heat protection is not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The open ice rink is insufficiently shielded and would require additional noise protection.

position.rationale: Adjacent rink is approximated at the open side beyond the building.

negative.statement: The staging works, but its individual phases are sometimes too intertwined.

position.rationale: Phasing criticism concerns operations globally rather than a model location.

negative.statement: The address formation and impermeability along the street leave questions unanswered.

position.rationale: Street-facing edge is approximated along the lower-left building perimeter.

negative.statement: The green roof is a major cost driver and appears expensive to maintain.

position.rationale: Distinct roof surface is visible, while cost and maintenance remain performance judgments.
